offers.name: Fresh skinless chicken breast (bone content not specified)
offers.restrictions: Ontario flyer October 29–November 4, 2026. Bone content, selected Kingston store participation, stock and packaging not independently confirmed; do not assume boneless or equivalent cuts.
offers.why: Advertised at $4.49/lb ($9.90/kg) in the Ontario October 29–November 4 flyer. The printed description says skinless, not boneless; a matching-cut comparison with Food Basics' boneless chicken is not established. A prior boneless designation and claimed $1.51/lb equivalent-cut saving were withdrawn as an editorial accuracy correction, not a retailer price change.
